dataset.name: LIAR (Wang, 2017)
dataset.exclusion_rationale: half-true and barely-true are ordinal middle classes; collapsing them into either pole injects label noise, so they are excluded from all splits.
dataset.split_policy: TRAIN: binary filter -> intra-split statement de-duplication -> removal of statements that also occur in VALID or TEST. VALID and TEST: binary filter only; no row is ever removed from a held-out split.

threshold_policy: Fixed at 0.50. Never tuned on TEST.
calibration: Platt sigmoid fitted on the disjoint VALID split

serving.limitation: text_meta was trained with a speaker credit-history block. It is used ONLY when the caller supplies that metadata. When metadata is absent the API serves text_only and reports metadata_available=false; it never evaluates text_meta with zero-filled metadata, because that is a mis-specified model and its accuracy claim would not hold.
